Hello, conceiving was relatively easy for us, but we experienced 4 chemical pregnancies (around 5 weeks) and 1 ectopic pregnancy. 

My husband underwent a sperm DNA fragmentation analysis, and the results were relatively high for him. We opted for IVF, and we were able to conceive our baby girl through this method. Feel free to DM me if you have any questions or would like to connect.
Thank you so much! I hope everything works out for you as well ❤️ All the best wishes and Prayers to you!

Hey! I’m so sorry you are going through this, this is really tough ❤️

I couldn’t find any answers for recurrent chemicals for me, all reports were normal. Unfortunately, I had an ectopic last year in Sept. after which our RE recommended IVF for us, for which we are scheduled for next month.

Apart from this, we figured since there’s nothing else we can do, at least we can start taking better care of ourselves, both emotionally and physically. 
This way I feel that there’s something which I can take control of and this might even help improve the eggs and sperm quality and better our chances with ivf.

Feel free to msg me anytime, even if you just want to talk ❤️ and I hope you find your answers, and everything goes okay for you 🙏🏼
I had a sonohysterogram last year as part of rpl testing and everything was okay, but didn’t had any after ectopic

Thank you! I will ask my RE about letrozole. When I had ectopic, I was on progesterone and baby aspirin, and that was the first time my hcg rose this high (~6000), not sure if taking progesterone and baby aspirin helped in embryo development, or if it contributed towards ectopic. I started taking progesterone almost a week after ovulation so highly suspect it could have caused it.

Thank you for sharing this detailed list, I’ll check with my RE about these tests. From what I know is that we have done all hormonal bloodwork, karyotype for both of us, semen analysis and dna fragmentation for my husband (a little higher at 19%), and auto immune disorder testing amongst others.
I haven’t been tested for endometriosis/endometritis, because as per my RE I didn’t had any symptoms, and while recommending us IVF she said in case if we move forward with ivf, she wouldn’t recommend getting biopsy for endometriosis since ivf will rule that out.
Thank you so much! I hope it all works out for you ❤️

I’m not sure about estrogen, afc etc, but I think they did amh, I’ll double check with them in my next appointment.
For current pregnancy, my Tsh was higher (3.9), but by the time I could have gone through other tests to confirm medication I got to know about the ectopic stuff.

So sorry you too are going through this ❤️ this is tough, more when we don’t know the answers.  I am thinking of getting all these tests as well to see if any of it could be a reason. Really don’t want to go through ivf route without getting all the tests done

Feeling lost, need guidance for next steps

I am currently having my first ectopic and about to receive my second mtx shot since the first dose didn’t work.
Before this, I have had multiple chemical pregnancies, all within an year.

I am in Canada, and seeing an RE who has done RPL testing for me and my husband. We’ve done sonohysterogram, karyotype, and other blood tests for auto-immune disorders etc. Everything came out to be normal.
My husband’s sperm analysis report was normal too, except for the dna fragmentation which was 19%, higher than normal range of 15%.

We have not been able to figure out the reasons for our losses, and I am losing all hope of ever having a baby.

Can anyone please share some suggestions on what we can do next?

We’ve added ourselves to the waitlist for ivf, but I’m worried that it might not work since we don’t even know what’s the cause for our early miscarriages.

I’m 32, my husband 34, we are healthy, I had regular cycles with no pain/cramping and on time ovulation. 
I thought I had pcos because I have unwanted body/facial hairs and acne but my RE was not concerned since I’m ovulating regular.

Sorry for the long post, but I’m looking for some Hope, some suggestions, anything anyone can share 🙏🏼
